title: Confirmation Bias (Part 2)
coreMove: Detect when the stereotyping pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Confirmation Bias (Part 2) as a specific decision error around stereotyping, counterevidence, belief filter. Traceable support includes Stereotyping.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Confirmation Bias (Part 2) as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the stereotyping pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.

sourceAnchors.name: Stereotyping
sourceAnchors.detail: Stereotyping as a special case of the confirmation bias , see: Roy F. Baumeister, The Cultural Animal: Human Nature, Meaning, and Social Life (Oxford, Oxford University Press, 2005), 198 - 200.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Stereotyping can appear as a factual pressure point: the reader sees confirmation bias (part 2) through evidence, not a decorative citation.
